messages.author: f1dfce49970ff8f1
messages.subject: n and spde.prefix required
parts:
Dear all,

I am probably missing something obvious, but I have been trying to fit a very simple spde model that used to work until recently; see example code below. INLA now requests 'n' and 'spde.prefix' to be specified in the formula for f(w, model='spde'). However, I have no idea what to enter here (help files show 'todo' for spde.prefix), and it wasn't requested before...

I would be very grateful if someone could help me solve this...

All the best,
Rob

#================
xs <- runif(100)
ys <- runif(100)
yy <- rnorm(100)

k <- 0.02
mesh <- inla.mesh.2d(loc=cbind(xs, ys), max.edge=c(0.5/k, 2/k)*1000, cutoff=(0.2/k)*1000)
A <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc=cbind(xs, ys), repl=1)
spde <- inla.spde2.matern(mesh, alpha=2)
w <- inla.spde.make.index(
  name="w",
  n.spde = spde$n.spde,
  n.group = 1,
  n.repl = 1
)

N <- 100
stk <- inla.stack(
  tag='huh',
  data= list(y=yy),
  A = list(A),
  effects = list(w = w))

f <- y ~ f(w, model='spde')
out <- inla(f, data=inla.stack.data(stk))

Error in INLA::f(w, model = "spde") :
  Argument `n' in f() is required for model: spde

f <- y ~ f(w, model='spde', n=1)
out <- inla(f, data=inla.stack.data(stk))

Error in INLA::f(w, model = "spde", n = 1) :
  Argument spde2.prefix=NULL is required for model = spde

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] n and spde.prefix required
parts:
Hi,

you need to supply your spde model object instead of the string literal 'spde', so f(..., model=spde) instead of f(..., model='spde').

Internally, inla needs the information in that object to fill in the needed arguments of the model that has internal name 'spde', hence the cryptic error messages.

Finn
